verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for any service that holds user-submitted data, including a state business-filing portal, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence describes user controls over how long data is kept or how it is deleted. Entity dissolution, reinstatement and registered-agent registration cancellation are business-lifecycle filings, not data-deletion controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
